name: first-class-sessions
description: Create one indexed row per authentication session and backfill held-schema keyed session documents without retaining plaintext bearer tokens.
statements: CREATE TABLE casino_sessions (session_id VARCHAR(191) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, token_digest CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(191) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, expires_at VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, generation BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, session_json JSON NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (session_id), UNIQUE KEY uq_casino_sessions_token_digest (token_digest), INDEX idx_casino_sessions_user_activity (user_id, status, updated_at, session_id), INDEX idx_casino_sessions_expiry (status, expires_at, session_id), CONSTRAINT chk_casino_sessions_token_digest CHECK (token_digest REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), CONSTRAINT chk_casino_sessions_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'revoked')), CONSTRAINT chk_casino_sessions_generation CHECK (generation BETWEEN 1 AND 9223372036854775807), CONSTRAINT chk_casino_sessions_payload CHECK (JSON_TYPE(session_json) = 'OBJECT' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(session_json, '$.session_id')) = session_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(session_json, '$.token_digest')) = token_digest AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(session_json, '$.user_id')) = user_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(session_json, '$.status')) = status AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(session_json, '$.updated_at')) = updated_at AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(session_json, '$.expires_at')) = expires_at AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(session_json, '$.generation')) AS UNSIGNED) = generation)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

INSERT INTO casino_sessions (session_id, token_digest, user_id, status, created_at, updated_at, expires_at, generation, session_json) SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.session_id')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.token_digest')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.user_id')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.status')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.created_at')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.updated_at')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.expires_at')), CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.generation')) AS UNSIGNED), payload_json FROM casino_documents WHERE document_key LIKE 'auth/session/v2/row/%' ORDER BY document_key
DELETE FROM casino_documents WHERE document_key LIKE 'auth/session/v2/row/%'
